publisher: US Campaign for Palestinian Rights Action (USCPR Action)

coverage.publisher_scope: Members of Congress in the Democratic Caucus; the feed also includes Independent senators.
coverage.lifetime_grade_period: Publisher methodology describes legislative action from 2023–2026, including the 119th Congress.
coverage.method: Publisher grades combine votes, letters, sponsorships and other legislative actions, plus additional factors; they are not vote-only scores. Grades and percentage scores are copied without recalculation.
limits: Absent members and N/A entries remain ungraded; absence does not mean F or establish a position.
This current feed does not supply grades for every former member or new candidate.
House districts identify the publisher's member record and must not be used to infer a 2026 ballot district.
The publisher's Lifetime label does not certify a complete career voting history; individual feed actions may predate the methodology's stated period.
This capture preserves attributed publisher assessments; it does not independently verify the underlying legislative actions.
